protocol.effect_size: Hedges' g on independent samples; the paired d Phase 8 reports is the correct significance test and the wrong effect size, because it divides by the sd of the difference
protocol.clustering: crossed learner and item random intercepts on every per-item model; a random learner intercept on every learner-level model
protocol.correction: Holm within each outcome family, raw and corrected both reported
protocol.censoring: Kaplan-Meier and log-rank for items-to-mastery; knowledge_gain is the uncensored co-primary
protocol.simulated: every closed-loop number here is simulated

closed_loop_items.note: a linear probability model: the outcome is binary, the coefficients are percentage-point differences in the chance of a correct answer, and no logistic mixed model is fitted because statsmodels' GLMM support does not cover crossed effects

assistments_2009.interpretation: rung_increment > 0 with a CI excluding zero means the higher rung adds signal the lower rung does not, after learner and item clustering

assistments_2012.interpretation: rung_increment > 0 with a CI excluding zero means the higher rung adds signal the lower rung does not, after learner and item clustering

rct_requirement.note: g = 0.3 is the effect this literature reports for adaptive instruction; the simulated effects above are not evidence that a real trial would see one, only that this design could detect it

censoring.why: most learners do not master inside the budget, so the mean of items_to_mastery is a lower bound on any difference, not the difference. The uncensored co-primary is knowledge_gain.
